issues.detail: The Hebrew says זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יִשְׁמָעֵ֜אל (Zebadiah son of Ishmael), but the Chinese renders it as '撒巴底雅兒子以實瑪利的官長' which reads as 'Zebadiah son of Ishmael's official' — this is ambiguous and could be misread as 'Ishmael's official' rather than 'Zebadiah son of Ishmael'. The proper name relationship is reversed/obscured, potentially changing who is the official.
